items.stem:
Study the pseudocode.

items.stem: MetroBus in Colombo needs a program that repeatedly inputs the weight of a parcel in kg. Input stops when a weight of 0 is entered. Parcels over 5 kg cost $12, parcels over 2 kg up to 5 kg cost $7 and other parcels cost $4. (a) Write pseudocode that outputs the cost of each parcel and the total cost at the end. (b) Justify your choice of loop.
items.answer:
Total ← 0
INPUT Weight
WHILE Weight <> 0
    IF Weight > 5 THEN
        Cost ← 12
    ELSE
        IF Weight > 2 THEN
            Cost ← 7
        ELSE
            Cost ← 4
        ENDIF
    ENDIF
    OUTPUT Cost
    Total ← Total + Cost
    INPUT Weight
ENDWHILE
OUTPUT Total
(b) A pre-condition loop, because the number of parcels is not known and the first input may be 0.
items.markingKey: (a) initialise total [1]; input before loop and inside loop [1]; loop ends on 0 [1]; correct selection for three bands [2]; output cost and add to total [1]; output total after loop [1] (b) [1]

items.stem: Nadia needs a subroutine CountChar for Lakeside College that returns the number of times a given character appears in a string. Write the pseudocode for CountChar.
items.answer:
FUNCTION CountChar(S : STRING, C : CHAR) RETURNS INTEGER
    DECLARE Total, i : INTEGER
    Total ← 0
    FOR i ← 1 TO LENGTH(S)
        IF MID(S, i, 1) = C THEN
            Total ← Total + 1
        ENDIF
    NEXT i
    RETURN Total
ENDFUNCTION

items.stem: Pioneer Insurance in Cape Town needs a program that repeatedly inputs the weight of a parcel in kg. Input stops when a weight of 0 is entered. Parcels over 19 kg cost $12, parcels over 2 kg up to 19 kg cost $7 and other parcels cost $4. (a) Write pseudocode that outputs the cost of each parcel and the total cost at the end. (b) Justify your choice of loop.
items.answer:
Total ← 0
INPUT Weight
WHILE Weight <> 0
    IF Weight > 19 THEN
        Cost ← 12
    ELSE
        IF Weight > 2 THEN
            Cost ← 7
        ELSE
            Cost ← 4
        ENDIF
    ENDIF
    OUTPUT Cost
    Total ← Total + Cost
    INPUT Weight
ENDWHILE
OUTPUT Total
